title: PEC adapter compatibility matrix
description: Schema for contracts/compatibility/pec-adapters.json, per Tech Spec v0.4 §1.6.2. Validated at build time (ENG-43).

validation_status.description: Overall document status. Individual capability entries in tested_with carry their own status.

pec_version.description: Exact PEC version, e.g. 5.4.37. Never a range.

postgresql_version.description: Exact PostgreSQL version, e.g. 9.6.13. Never a range.

capability.description: Adapter capability identifier, e.g. individual_encounter_modality. Not a fixed enum — the spec's capability list is explicitly non-exhaustive.

status_reason.description: Required when status is BLOCKED or when a sub-case within the capability is NOT_TESTED.

signature_fingerprint.description: Hash of object name + column names/types + any frozen value-set (e.g. leaf-id list) this capability depends on. A change blocks this capability, per ENG-02.

binding_column.description: e.g. tb_dim_municipio.co_ibge — never an installation-local surrogate key.

test_evidence_ref.description: Path to the discovery doc or test report backing this entry.
